answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks using hierarchical, stake-weighted trust graphs. Rather than allowing an unverified nebula of autonomous nodes to interact unchecked, the network enforces a curated garden of attested credentials. By structuring reputation and validation thresholds across a collateral terrace where nodes must lock bonded assets to gain influence, an adversary incurs severe capital lockup and slashing costs for every counterfeit identity spawned.
